scientific_integrity: The forward stationary membrane equations and entropy functional are credited to published literature. The additional claim concerns inverse identifiability and its exact symmetry kernel. Independent publication priority and independent scientific audit remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary signed currents as a function of reset rate; constant unknown source distribution, known ring length, diffusivity and membrane permeability; no stability, finite-sample recovery or noisy-data inference; no unknown coefficient identification, no non-Poisson resets.
title: Boundary-current tomography and its reflection-blind subspace in a resetting diffusion ring
